part.text:
Implemented incremental builds and caching for the SSG.

**What changed:**
- `src/cache.ts` (new): `.ssg-cache.json` manifest with SHA-256 source hashes, template hashes (all templates/layouts/partials), plugin signatures, cached rendered HTML + parsed frontmatter, and per-page render times.
- `src/engine.ts`: incremental build logic — reads cache, skips the plugin pipeline for pages whose source + template hash match, restores cached HTML/frontmatter, saves updated manifest, and reports `BuildStats` (built/skipped/timeSaved/time). Full rebuild when cache is missing, `--clean`, template hash change, or plugin set change.
- `src/types.ts`: added `BuildStats`; `BuildResult.stats` (optional, non-breaking).
- `src/generator.ts`: added `incremental`, `clean`, `cacheFile` build options.
- `src/cli.ts`: added `--incremental` and `--clean` flags; prints `Build stats: N built, M skipped, X ms saved`.
- `src/plugins/dev-server.ts`: dev-server rebuilds now use incremental builds.
- `tests/incremental.test.ts` (new): 14 tests covering skip-on-unchanged, single-source invalidation, template/partial invalidation, missing cache, `--clean`, frontmatter reuse, index regeneration, stats reporting, and cache file exclusion.

Verified CLI end-to-end: 2 built → 0 built/2 skipped → 1 built/1 skipped after edit → 2 built with `--clean`. Plugin architecture and existing tests untouched.
